items.title: MDLZ Q2 Sales Beat and Higher 2026 Growth View Put Margins in Focus
items.summary: Mondelez beat Q2 sales and earnings estimates and raised its 2026 organic growth outlook, but margin pressure keeps earnings conversion in focus.

items.title: Is MDLZ Worth Buying as Growth Improves but Valuation Stays Rich?
items.summary: Mondelez's growth is broadening as North America rebounds and Emerging Markets stay firm, but Europe, chocolate weakness and rich valuation cloud the case.
